name: Takeda frees Cassie's squad from Kotal's custody
description: While Cassie's team remains imprisoned in Outworld, Takeda uses his telepathic abilities to incapacitate a guard, take the keys, and free Cassie, Jacqui, and Kung Jin. The escape directly answers Kotal Kahn's detention decision, while D'Vorah's parallel theft and escape remain a separate branch until the freed team encounters Kotal's retainers.
